children: Vodafone’s first-half fiscal 2027 revenue rose 11.4% to €21.85 billion, while organic service revenue grew 5.8%. It raised full-year adjusted EBITDAaL and free cash flow forecasts.
Vodafone reported a first-half net loss, reversing a year-earlier profit, as impairments tied mainly to German operations and a UK tax write-down weighed on results. Operating profit also declined.
Analysts cut Vodafone ADR’s average 12-month price target to $16.13 from $16.33, implying about 3% upside from its Nov. 9 close. Targets range from $12.59 to $21.44; consensus remains Hold.
Vodafone Business posted record service revenue growth of 6.6% in Q2, while digital services revenue rose more than 20% year over year. It also launched an AI Concierge for small businesses.
Vodafone (VOD) targets over €2 billion in annual gross expense savings across Europe and shared operations by fiscal 2030. Its program has already generated over €200 million in European savings.
Vodafone (VOD) lost about 100,000 German broadband customers in each of the past two quarters, ending September with 9.7 million. Customers switched from its cable service to rivals’ fibre.
Vodafone Group Public Limited Company Sponsored ADR (VOD) began its Q2 2027 quarterly earnings call.
